subject: Postcard campaign: promotional trial codes for demo outreach

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Custom postcard run for Acme Health — can we include trial codes?

Hi Rafael and Marissa,

Hope you're both well — quick one from the campaign team here. Acme Health is running a targeted postcard mailer to 8,500 clinicians to promote a short demo and trial sign-up. They asked if we can include a short promo code that grants a 30-day trial plus $75 in starter credits redeemable on signup.

We can print a small QR and short code on the card; deliverable would be a CSV of unique codes and a sample postcard design (attached). Timeline: printing files by Sep 28, drop early Oct.

Can Redwood approve a promo batch for this partner? If yes, we'll need the CSV of codes and a redemption landing link to embed.

Attachments: postcard_sample.png (PNG)

Best,
Lena
Lena Ortiz
Account Lead, Postcard Co.
-lena@postcard.co

Forwarding Lena's note — quick thoughts: this is a partner-driven, co-funded mailer (Acme covers print) and they want a small starter grant to increase trial conversions. Estimated reach 8.5k clinicians.

Ask: approve a batch of unique single-use promo codes with 30-day trial + $75 credit attached. I want to confirm budget hit and redemption limits.

Questions for Kimberly / Finance:
- What is the standard starter-credit cap for partner mailers of this size?
- Should codes be single-use or multi-use (we generally prefer single-use for attribution).

Marissa — if we greenlight, can you coordinate code generation and landing URL? I can copy Acme and Lena on final delivery.

Thanks,
Rafael
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Custom postcard run for Acme Health — can we include trial codes?

Thanks for the heads-up. High level: OK to approve on conditionals below.

Proposed allocation:
- Total codes: 9,000 single-use codes (slight buffer for misprints)
- Redemption: 30-day free trial + $75 starter credits, auto-expire 60 days after issuance
- Cap per company: 1 code per unique email/account to avoid abuse
- Financial guardrail: assume 15% redemption; treat as marketing expense (Partner Co-op).

Requirements before I sign off:
1) Marissa to provide the landing URL & test flow + confirmation that code redemption ties to HubSpot deal ACME-2026-089 for attribution.
2) Internal approval from Partnerships budget (Grace) — I left Grace on cc.
3) Final CSV of codes to be uploaded to our promo engine and QA-tested (no PII in the CSV).

Once Marissa confirms the flow and Grace signs off on budget, I'll route a formal internal approval note to Finance.

-Kimberly
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
